attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 3, `gabT` to `glaH`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 1% of calls. The model names 99% of them, and no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits.

**A fork follows at columns 4 and 5**, carried by 54 to 66%, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 59%. Through columns 49 to 51, `rseA` to `rseC`, a group runs, [[sigma factor regulation]].

**Here the model names fewer genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 83 against 89%, and hesitates more there, 0.88 against 0.57 bits. Its most hesitant column, 4, is a fork column, at 4.51 bits.

**The window ends on variable columns and forks.** Columns 73 to 77, `glyA` to `yphE`, are carried by 3 to 50%, all persistent. The last column is `yphC`, in 39% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 88% of genes**, 0.64 bits on average, perplexity 2.0 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 2.17 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 52% against 98%.

label: gabT
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the gabT window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gabT, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,069 to 1,148 from dnaA. Read in 528 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gabT once); 42,240 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.64 bits on average (perplexity 2.0 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,447 calls, named 99%, 0.19 bits; shell 7,459 calls, named 60%, 1.76 bits; cloud 2,334 calls, named 20%, 3.33 bits. Outside an RGP 32,666 calls, named 98%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 9,574 calls, named 52%, 2.17 bits. Columns: 18 spine, 8 fork, 54 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.17 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (52% against 98%); 9,574 of the 42,240 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 4 ("ATPase", a fork column) 4.51 bits, RGP 59%; column 5 (ypjA, a fork column) 3.20 bits, RGP 59%; column 6 (smpB, a spine column) 2.46 bits, RGP 59%. The 4 columns (columns 4-7) where most calls are in an RGP: named 63%, 2.95 bits on average; the other 76 columns: named 89%, 0.52 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 18 spine columns: named 83%, 0.88 bits on average; the 62 fork and variable columns: named 89%, 0.57 bits. The model names fewer genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates more there. Its most hesitant column, 4, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 4-5 (fork), RGP 59%; the least: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0-1%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: gabT, gabD "NADP-dependent succinate-semialdehy…", lhgO, glaH. named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 3 (glaH)).
[S2] 2. columns 4-5 (2 columns) fork: share 54-66%, 1 P, 1 S, RGP 59%. named 56%; most hesitant at column 4, 4.51 bits.
[S2.c4]    4: "ATPase" P 66%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 28%, ygaR S 24%
[S2.c5]    5: ypjA S 54% "adhesin-like autotransporter YpjA/E…"; also ypjCB S 13%, "ParB/RepB/Spo0J family partition protein" S 11%
[S3] 3. columns 6-19 (14 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 33-59%. Genes: smpB, ratA, yfjF "RnfH family protein", bamE, recN, nadK, grpE, yfjD "HlyC/CorC family transporter", ypjD "cytochrome C assembly family protein", ffh, rpsP, rimM, trmD, rplS. named 67-83% (mean 79%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6 (smpB), named 67%, 2.46 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 20-79 (60 columns) fork and variable columns: share 3-88%, 58 P, 2 S, RGP 12-32%. named 80-94% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 21, named 80%; most hesitant at column 20, 1.02 bits.
